create_dqn_config: create a DQNConfig dataclass instance with default exploration and learning rate settings
configure_dqn_epsilon: configure the DQNConfig epsilon field to set epsilon-greedy exploration policy values
set_dqn_learning_rate: set the DQNConfig learning rate to a float or callable schedule function
configure_dqn_replay: configure DQNConfig replay buffer options like batch size and priority sampling exponents
generate_logspace_epsilons: generate logspace-distributed epsilon values using logspace_epsilons with a given count and median
